entities.text:
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 
 Tejveer
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr. Arun Kumar, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 18/08/2023

Learned counsel for the petitioner does not press the present anticipatory bail application and seeks liberty that the petitioner may be permitted to surrender before the trial court and file an application for bail.
Accordingly, the instant application for anticipatory bail is dismissed as not pressed.
The petitioner is directed to surrender before the trial court on or before 25.08.2023 and file an application for bail.
It is expected from the trial Court that the bail application will be decided expeditiously.

Till 25.08.2023, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.066/2023, registered at Police Station Rajaldesar, District Churu, for the offences under Sections 420, 406 and 120-B of IPC.
